description: Screen a token contract on Base before an agent buys it. Reads the contract (ERC-20 metadata, owner, upgradeable proxy, and mint / pause / blacklist / fee selectors in its bytecode) and its DEX liquidity (WETH and USDC held by its Uniswap and Aerodrome pools, read on-chain). Returns a verdict — ok, caution, avoid or unknown — with the reasons. A heuristic screen: it does not simulate a sell, read tax rates or check pool age. Wraps GET /v1/token/check. Same free daily tier as read_url; $0.01/call via x402 after that.
